en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-129 Al-Hassan ibn Abdullah ibn Sa’id al-Askari narrated that the judge - Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Walid quoted Yahya ibn Hatam, on the authority of Yazid ibn Harun, on the authority of Shu’bat, on the authority of Al-A’amash, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Mar’rat, on the authority of Masruq, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Masood that the Prophet (MGB) said,

“Whoever possesses four characteristics is a hypocrite. Even if one has only one of these characteristics he is a hypocrite, unless he gives up that characteristic: one who lies when he talks; one who breaks his promises; one who breaks his pledges; and one who cheats when he fights.”
